kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
ينتكس (form VIII)
# يَنْتَكِسُ (yantakisu) /jan.ta.ki.su/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِنْتَكَسَ (intakasa)
# يَنْتَكِسَ (yantakisa) /jan.ta.ki.sa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْتَكَسَ (intakasa)
# يَنْتَكِسْ (yantakis) /jan.ta.kis/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِنْتَكَسَ (intakasa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
